verdicts.note: The evidence is party independence ('No party machines', 'prosecutors serve their communities, not political parties', filed as an independent to stay free of partisan influence) [S1][S2][S6], not the money-in-politics or structural reforms the reform axis names (refusing PAC money, term limits, dark-money bans, RCV). The same dossier lists endorsements from two political parties (Working Families Party; Green Party preferred candidate), Fuse Washington, Run For Something and a slate of Democratic officials [S4], which cuts against the independence reading. Direction kept; confidence is an indirect inference.
